name: Guyana
summary: A green field with a yellow arrowhead edged in white pointing from the hoist, overlaid by a red triangle edged in black. Designed by the American vexillologist Whitney Smith, who coined the word 'vexillology'.
origin: Whitney Smith proposed the design in 1960. The British College of Arms modified it, adding the white and black edging, and it was adopted at independence on 26 May 1966.

symbols.name: Golden arrowhead
symbols.description: A yellow triangle pointing toward the fly.

facts: Whitney Smith, its designer, founded the Flag Research Center and coined the term 'vexillology' in 1957.
Guyana is the only English-speaking country in South America.
clues: A yellow arrowhead and red triangle edged in white and black on green.
